The person asks:
When do I have to object to the 2025 service-charge statement?

response.text:
You must raise any objections to the 2025 operating and heating cost statement by **Fri 10 Sep 2027** (post by **Sun 6 Sep 2027**) [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc].

- If you think any figures in the statement are wrong, notify Wohnbau Musterstadt eG in writing before that deadline [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc] [party:pty_4by2mq3ac4sk].
- This is separate from the additional payment (Nachzahlung) of 184.30 € due Fri 9 Oct 2026 [item:itm_dmaw27qvv18n] — that payment deadline is not affected by the objection deadline.

You can use "Draft letter" in Ordnung to prepare your objection if needed.
